mapper.update: UPDATE failure_submit SET status = 1, retry_time = NOW(), retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE failure_submit_id = #{failureSubmitId} AND status IN (0, 3)

UPDATE failure_submit SET status = #{status}, retry_time = NOW(), last_error = CASE WHEN #{status} = 2 THEN NULL ELSE last_error END WHERE failure_submit_id = #{failureSubmitId} AND status != #{status}

UPDATE failure_submit fs INNER JOIN submit_record sr ON sr.submit_record_id = fs.submit_record_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT submit_record_id FROM judge_record ) jr ON jr.submit_record_id = fs.submit_record_id SET fs.status = CASE WHEN jr.submit_record_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 2 END, fs.retry_time = NOW(), fs.last_error = CASE WHEN jr.submit_record_id IS NULL THEN fs.last_error ELSE NULL END, sr.judge_status = CASE WHEN jr.submit_record_id IS NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'success' END WHERE fs.status IN (1, 3) AND COALESCE(fs.retry_time, fs.create_time) <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
